pp_desc: Privacy policy for the Android app Ripen: the camera presence check runs on your device and never saves or sends images, how Usage access and Accessibility are used, on-device storage and Android backup, and how to delete your data.
pp_authority: This is a translation. If it differs from the Japanese version, the Japanese version prevails.
pp_intro: Ripen (“the app”) is an Android app developed and provided by Ramune. It’s a reward-based habit app: by stacking focus sessions and word practice, you earn time for social and video apps. This policy explains what information the app handles and how.
pp_callout: In short: the app has no accounts and sends no data to Ramune’s servers. The camera presence check runs on your device, and no images are saved or sent. Focus records and settings are stored on your device (if Android backup is on, they are included in your Google Account backup).
pp_s1_p: During focus sessions in time windows where the presence check is on, the app uses the front camera only to judge whether a person is in front of the screen (presence).
pp_s1_li1: Face detection runs entirely on your device using Google ML Kit.
pp_s1_li2: Camera footage and images are never saved, and never sent anywhere — not to Ramune’s servers and not to any third party.
pp_s1_li3: It only judges whether a face is present. It does not identify individuals or analyze expression, age or anything similar.
pp_s1_li4: The only records kept are numbers, such as the time (in seconds) you were present and focused.
pp_s1_li5: The camera permission is requested the first time you start focusing in a window with the presence check on. In windows with it turned off, and for focus outside your windows, the camera is never started.
pp_s2_p: To block apps and measure usage time, the app uses special Android permissions. The app does not continue to its home screen until both are enabled.
pp_s2_li1: Usage access: used to total each app’s foreground usage time — to spend your usable time, for dashboard analytics, and to show usage time when you choose apps to block.
pp_s2_li2: Accessibility (AccessibilityService API): used only to identify the app currently in the foreground and show a block screen over an app you chose when your usable time is zero (or during a focus session). Before opening the settings, the app explains this use and asks for your consent.
pp_s2_li3: Information obtained through these permissions is used only for processing on your device and is never sent externally. The app never reads or records screen content or what you type.
pp_s2_li4: So that you can choose apps to block, the app reads the list of installed apps (names, icons and categories) on your device. This list is not sent externally either.
pp_s3_p: The app shows today’s status (usable time, the next focus window and the time left in a session) in a persistent notification, and plays a sound and vibrates when you finish a focus session. Allowing notifications is optional; the app works without it. Notification content is created on your device and not sent externally.
pp_s4_p: Through the app, Ramune does not collect any of the following:
pp_s4_li1: Personally identifiable information such as your name or email address
pp_s4_li4: Contacts, call logs, browsing history or screen content
pp_s5_p: Focus session records, time-window settings, blocked-app selections, word progress and your own decks, and other preferences are stored on your device (in an SQLite database and settings storage). They are never stored on servers operated by Ramune.
pp_s5_p2: The app supports Android Auto Backup. If Google backup is on for your device, the settings and records above are saved to your Google Account backup (Google Drive) and restored when you reinstall with the same account. This backup is provided by Google as part of Android; Ramune cannot access its contents. You can turn backup off in your device settings.
pp_s6_p: The app contains no advertising SDKs, analytics tools or tracking services. Google ML Kit, used for face detection, runs on your device and does not send camera images externally. Google may collect information such as API usage, device model and OS version to provide and improve ML Kit (Google’s privacy policy applies).
pp_s7_p: Items in Settings such as “Rate this app”, “Send feedback” and “Privacy policy” open external pages in Google Play or your browser. Only if you submit the contact form do we receive what you entered (including an optional email address, attachment and display language), and we use it only to respond to your inquiry. This website uses Google Analytics to understand how pages are viewed.
pp_s8_p: You can delete the app’s data in the following ways:
pp_s8_li1: Uninstalling the app deletes all of its data on your device.
pp_s8_li2: You can delete the data anytime via Android Settings › Apps › Ripen › Storage › Clear data.
pp_s8_li3: Backups remaining in your Google Account can be deleted from your device’s Google backup settings.
pp_s8_li4: To have a message you sent through the contact form deleted, please contact us through the form.
pp_s9_p: The app is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.
pp_s10_p: We may revise this Privacy Policy as needed. When we do, we will update the “Last updated” date at the top of this page.
pp_s11_p: For questions about this Privacy Policy, please reach out via our contact form.
